# Spacetop Copilot Instructions

This file is a loader, not a separate policy.

Before answering repository questions, changing code, or reviewing a pull
request, read and follow:

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `docs/code-review-policy.md`

For GitHub Copilot code review, use `docs/code-review-policy.md` as the
canonical review policy. Do not maintain separate review rules in this file. If
you cannot inspect the shared policy file, say that the review is incomplete
because the shared policy was unavailable.
